scripts.cap:android: vite build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: vite build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:release: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:release: vite build && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath build/SWIM.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive
